public_rationale: The checkable mathematical attribution is contradicted. OpenAI explicitly says hallucinations are not inevitable because models can abstain. Its paper limits the relevant inevitability result to base models under statistical assumptions and discusses non-hallucinating restricted systems. This does not prove that ordinary deployed assistants are error-free. It also does not settle whether models have thoughts or knowledge.
limitations: The verdict addresses the universal mathematical attribution, not consciousness.
The narrower claim that present systems retain practical hallucination risks is compatible with the research.
Abstention can avoid false assertions while sacrificing useful answers.
